one_line: Proves H6 >= 0 and H8 >= 0 at realizable points on one 8-generator face of the T_47 cone. Every identity replayed EXACT; the logic is sound; it rests on the preceding negative-j-Heron theorem and its principal-minor mechanism, the HMSV set equality and Prop. C.6, all CITED.

statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.restatement: Let T = {1,3,5,6,7,8} = paper T_47 (literal). Let c = q f27 + p f1 + j f59 + c f5 + e f2 + d f28 + b f6 + a f4 with all coefficients >= 0 and b, j, d > 0. This is one simplicial 8-generator face of N_T, which has 10 generators; it omits f0 = n1,4 and f3 = n14,34. If c = c(x) for some x in X (with the restored real height), then H6 >= 0 and H8 >= 0, where disc_j G = (q+d)^2 H6 H8 and H6 = T0^2 + 4bDM(q-c)(q-e).
